channel.title: Free Fax Desk - What's new
channel.description: What shipped in Free Fax Desk, newest first.

item.title: Road: the office faxes on your phone, and the field back to the office
item.description: FaxDesk Road puts the office faxes on the team's phones and brings signed forms back from the field - sealed to each phone's own key. The relay carries locked envelopes only; nothing readable ever leaves the office PC or the phone.

item.title: Search the words inside your faxes
item.description: FaxDesk now reads every incoming fax as it arrives (OCR, on your own PC) so you can type a patient name, a claim number or a payer and see which faxes contain it - and jump to the page.

item.title: Know when a fax actually arrived
item.description: FaxDesk now watches every sent fax for 90 minutes and tells you, in plain words, whether the other machine took it - with a Resend button when it did not.

item.title: Fax never went away. It went digital.
item.description: The launch story behind Free Fax Desk: a busy healthcare front desk, a pile of faxes nobody owned, and the smarter shared inbox it built for its digital fax number.

item.title: Tell us how it's going
item.description: A thirty-second review page, a wall where reviews appear, and a founding list for one short email when something ships.

item.title: Done, with a reason - and a tidier look
item.description: Close a fax with one click, add a reason with one more tap if you want, block junk senders as you mark them, and close several at once. New colours and a single EXE, no installer.

item.title: See it in fifty seconds
item.description: A short captioned demo: faxes arriving with names on them, one assigned, one blocked, one sent with a cover sheet.

item.title: Get your Phone.com key in five minutes
item.description: The one setup step people got stuck on, with screenshots: where the API Client tool lives, what a permanent token is, how Test connection shows your account id, and the three mistakes that give a red X.

item.title: Not on Phone.com? Tell us what you use
item.description: FaxDesk is the desk; your fax service is the line. The list of services whose inbox a PC can poll - Phone.com tested, SRFax next, Phaxio, Documo, Fax.Plus, WestFax, RingCentral planned.

item.title: Free Fax Desk 1.0: one file, no installer, nothing phones home
item.description: The first public release: download one EXE, double-click, open the page. Your token is sealed on the PC. No cloud account, no analytics, no update checks. Free for one desk; one payment for the whole office.

item.title: Faxes arrive with a name on them
item.description: A fax from +1 818 555 0177 tells you nothing. Name the number once and every fax from it arrives labelled. Pair a regular sender with a person or team and it is pre-sorted.

item.title: An owner for every fax
item.description: Open a fax and it is yours; hand it to a person or team with one click. To handle, New, Mine, Unassigned, All, Spam - and a red count in the browser tab when something is waiting for you.

item.title: Sending is drag, click, done
item.description: Drop a PDF, pick who it goes to, add a cover note, confirm the number once. A background worker sends it within the minute and retries busy lines on its own. Every send gets a confirmation page.

item.title: A cover sheet with your logo
item.description: Upload your logo once and every outgoing fax leads with a clean cover: office, to, from, subject, your note, an optional disclaimer line. Preview before you send.

item.title: You decide how long faxes stay
item.description: Incoming and outgoing faxes are kept for a number of days you set, then removed. A dated backup folder is written on the same machine every day. The audit log never records the contents of a fax.
